title: Aureline M5 progress-marker component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the progress-marker family binds inside the frozen M5 learning-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-learning-component-matrix.schema.json). A progress marker names who owns a learner's progress and where it stands so progress stays user-owned and default-local unless a supported sync or export path is explicitly chosen. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-learning is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
